authorityCeiling.basis: The paper states PMLA / Vault stores semantic history, provenance, receipts, topology deltas, and outcome calibration. Storage is not one of the Section 3.3 authority levels (observe, recommend, draft, stage, execute, emergency block), and the paper assigns no authority level to PMLA / Vault, so no level is claimed.

Role quote: "Stores semantic history, provenance, receipts, topology deltas, and outcome calibration." Boundary quote: "Bitmasks cannot become the only memory representation." Neither assigns a Section 3.3 authority level to storage.

capabilityFamilies.basis: Role quote: "Stores semantic history, provenance, receipts, topology deltas, and outcome calibration."

lifecycleStages.basis: Section 3.3 defines lifecycleMask as workflow stage and completion state but names no stages. The paper assigns no lifecycle stages to PMLA / Vault.

memoryPlanes.basis: Role quote: "Stores semantic history, provenance, receipts, topology deltas, and outcome calibration." The role literally names semantic history (semantic plane) and outcome calibration (outcome plane); stored history is an episodic record (episodic plane).

outputClasses.basis: Role quote: "Stores semantic history, provenance, receipts, topology deltas, and outcome calibration." Stored receipts and provenance records are artifacts.

permittedRoutes.basis: The paper defines routeMask semantics in Sections 3.2 and 3.3 but names no per-organ routes for PMLA / Vault.

paperBoundary: Bitmasks cannot become the only memory representation.
paperRole: Stores semantic history, provenance, receipts, topology deltas, and outcome calibration.
paperSource: N-Cell position paper, Section 4 mapping table, https://ncell-position-paper.pages.dev/, accessed 2026-11-14.
